Construction of Biomimetic Tissues with Anisotropic Structures via Stepwise Algorithm‐Assisted Bioprinting (Small 46/2022)

High AI for Bioprinting openalex Direct Read now in_vitro Exp. validation
Cuidi Li, Jialei Chen, Tianyang Jie, Wen Wu, Kan Wang et al. Small 2022-11-01 10.1002/smll.202270249
单位: Department of Orthopaedics Shanghai Key Laboratory for Prevention and Treatment of Bone and Joint Diseases Shanghai Institute of Traumatology and Orthopaedics Ruijin Hospital Shanghai Jiao Tong Univer
通讯: Cuidi Li @ Department of Orthopaedics Shanghai Key Laboratory for Prevention and Treatment of Bone and Joint Diseases Shanghai Inst
相关性: 本文通过算法辅助打印实现了具有各向异性结构的仿生组织构建，对AI辅助生物打印的路径规划阶段有直接参考价值。
边界: The paper does not involve autonomous decision-making or real-time process control, which are key for advancing to full autonomous bioprinting.
动机· 构建具有可定制各向异性微结构的仿生组织
方法· 通过逐步算法生成最小自由能的各向异性网格并优化打印路径
结果· 成功定制出具有仿生化组成、各向异性结构和生物学性能的骨组织
验证· 结合钙磷基生物墨水进行骨组织打印与性能表征
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To construct biomimetic tissues with customizable anisotropic microstructures via algorithm-assisted bioprinting.
Method· A stepwise algorithm generates anisotropic mesh patterns with minimum free energy and optimizes printing paths.
Result· The approach successfully customizes bones with biomimetic chemical compositions, anisotropic microstructures, and biological properties.
Validation· The bioprinted bones were validated through chemical, structural, and biological characterization.

MAgNET: A Graph U-Net Architecture for Mesh-Based Simulations

High FEA & Surrogate Modelling arxiv Direct Read now simulation_case
Saurabh Deshpande, Stéphane P. A. Bordas, Jakub Lengiewicz arXiv preprint 2022-11-01 10.1016/j.engappai.2024.108055
相关性: 该论文提出的图U-Net架构直接用于固体力学有限元代理建模，与用户的研究方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not include uncertainty quantification, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics-specific validation.
动机· 高保真计算模型太慢，需要快速代理模型。
方法· 提出MAgNET，一种图U-Net架构，包含多通道聚合层和图池化/反池化层。
结果· 在非线性固体力学有限元仿真中展示了代理建模的预测能力。
验证· 通过非线性有限元仿真案例验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· High-fidelity computational models are too slow for practical use, necessitating faster surrogate models.
Method· MAgNET extends convolutional U-Nets to arbitrary graph-structured data using Multichannel Aggregation (MAg) layers and graph pooling/unpooling layers.
Result· The proposed graph U-Net demonstrates predictive capability for surrogate modeling of nonlinear finite element simulations in solid mechanics.
Validation· Validation is performed on nonlinear finite element simulation cases in solid mechanics.

单位: CFD Lab, Department of Mechanical Engineering, University of California, Berkeley, CA, USA
通讯: Haris Moazam Sheikh @ CFD Lab, Department of Mechanical Engineering, University of California, Berkeley, CA, USA
相关性: 该论文提出的混合变量多目标贝叶斯优化方法可直接迁移至植入物设计中的多目标约束优化问题。
边界: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it include any biomedical context or experimental validation.
动机· 解决工程设计中混合变量多目标优化问题的高效求解需求。
方法· 提出一种结合高斯过程与期望改进准则的贝叶斯优化框架，支持混合变量和约束处理。

Motivation· To efficiently solve multi-objective optimization problems with mixed continuous and categorical variables under constraints.
Method· A Bayesian optimization framework using Gaussian processes and an acquisition function that handles mixed-variable spaces and multiple constraints.
Result· The method demonstrates improved sampling efficiency and Pareto front quality on several numerical benchmark problems.
Validation· Validation is performed on standard multi-objective optimization test functions with numerical comparisons.

通讯: Abdelhak Ouldyerou @ Department of Mechanical Engineering, Faculty of Science and Technology, University of Mascara, Mascara, Algeria. Ele  |  Ali Merdji @ Department of Mechanical Engineering, Faculty of Science and Technology, University of Mascara, Mascara, Algeria; Labora  |  Laid Aminallah @ Department of Mechanical Engineering, Faculty of Science and Technology, University of Mascara, Mascara, Algeria. Electr  |  Ali Mehboob @ Department of Textile Engineering, School of Engineering and Technology, National Textile University, Faisalabad, Pakist  |  Osama M Mukdadi @ Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, West Virginia University, Morgantown, WV, 26506, USA. Electronic add
相关性: 该论文通过功能梯度材料设计分析了应力遮挡问题，但缺乏LPBF制造和实验验证，对用户的研究方向有一定参考价值。
边界: This paper is a pure simulation study without LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing, fatigue analysis, or surface characterization.
动机· 传统牙种植体因刚度不匹配导致应力遮挡，需优化设计匹配骨密度。
方法· 设计了五种轴向与径向功能梯度材料种植体，并模拟不同骨密度下的力学响应。
结果· 功能梯度材料种植体在高密度骨中产生更优应变，传统种植体在低密度骨中更优。
验证· 仅通过有限元仿真对比应变分布，无实验验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Conventional dental implants cause stress shielding due to stiffness mismatch; functionally graded materials can tailor implant stiffness to different bone densities.
Method· Five axial and radial functionally graded material (FGM) implant designs were simulated with five bone densities using finite element analysis.
Result· FGM implants induced optimal strain (990-1280 με) in high-density bone, whereas conventional implants were optimal (1000-2240 με) in low-density bone.
Validation· The study relied solely on computational simulation without experimental fabrication or mechanical testing.

Bingjing Zhao, Changkui Liu, Zenghui Sun, Xiaowen Zhao, Min Hu The International Journal of Oral & Maxillofacial Implants 2022-11-01 10.11607/jomi.9632
相关性: 该论文涉及SLM制造牙科植入体、表面特性和生物相容性，但与多孔结构、疲劳测试或应力屏蔽的直接关联有限。
边界: This paper evaluates SLM-fabricated root-analog implants with FEA and static compression, but does not consider porous design, fatigue testing, or direct stress shielding quantification.
动机· 评估选择性激光熔化制造的根形植入体的性能。
方法· 设计并SLM制造根形和螺钉型植入体，进行有限元分析和力学、表面、生物相容性测试。
结果· 根形植入体应力分布更佳且微动更小，两者均能承受咀嚼力。
验证· 通过压缩测试、表面表征和体外生物实验验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the performance of root-analog dental implants fabricated by selective laser melting.
Method· Two implant types (root-analog and screw-cylinder) were designed and fabricated via SLM, then evaluated by finite element analysis, mechanical testing, surface characterization, and in vitro biocompatibility assays.
Result· The root-analog implant showed better stress distribution and less micromotion, while both implant types withstood masticatory forces.
Validation· Validation included compression testing, surface morphology and roughness measurements, contact angle tests, and osteoblast attachment and viability assays.

单位: State Key Laboratory of Metal Matrix Composites, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, 800 Dongchuan Road, Shanghai, 200240, PR China
通讯: Yujin Tang @ Guangxi Key Laboratory of Basic and Translational Research of Bone and Joint Degenerative Diseases, Baise 533000, Guangx  |  Jia Liu @ National Center for Translational Medicine, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai, China  |  Liqiang Wang @ State Key Laboratory of Metal Matrix Composites, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, 800 Dongchuan Road, Shanghai, 200240, PR
相关性: 该论文设计了基于三周期极小曲面的连续梯度多孔支架，通过LPBF制造并进行了力学性能测试，与用户研究方向中的多孔结构、刚度匹配和AM制造直接相关。
边界: does not evaluate fatigue behavior, surface roughness, as-built morphology, or osseointegration; stress shielding is only indirectly addressed via elastic modulus matching.
动机· 设计和制造与骨匹配力学性能的连续梯度多孔支架。
方法· 基于P、G、D三种TPMS结构设计梯度多孔支架，采用LPBF制备NiTiNb合金样品。
结果· 支架弹性模量1.5-3.4 GPa，强度75-321 MPa，与人体骨匹配，P型结构综合性能最优。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Design a bone-like scaffold with continuous porosity gradient that matches the mechanical properties of human bone.
Method· Used three TPMS unit cells (Primitive, Gyroid, Diamond) to design gradient porous scaffolds, fabricated by selective laser melting of NiTiNb alloy.
Result· Scaffolds achieved low elastic modulus (1.5–3.4 GPa) and suitable strength (75–321 MPa), with P-type showing best mechanical and permeability performance.
Validation· Compression tests and permeability calculations were performed to verify mechanical and fluid transport properties.

Motivation· To investigate the microstructural evolution and failure mechanism of LPBF Ti-6Al-4V under low cycle fatigue at room and elevated temperatures.
Method· Tensile and strain-controlled low cycle fatigue tests were conducted at room temperature and 400°C, with EBSD analysis of α' grains and dislocation density.
Result· Cyclic softening was attributed to dislocation substructure evolution, and surface defects (lack-of-fusion voids, microcracks) acted as crack initiation sites leading to intergranular fracture.
Validation· Experimental validation through mechanical testing and microstructural characterization.

相关性: 该论文提出了一种多尺度数据驱动方法，用于微机电系统的随机效应量化，其不确定性量化框架可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的代理建模。
边界: This paper focuses on MEMS magnetometers, not on implant biomechanics or FEA surrogate modeling for biomedical applications; no validation on bone-implant interface or stress shielding.
动机· 微机电系统多尺度建模中未考虑随机效应，导致实验数据分散。
方法· 提出多尺度深度学习方法，结合CNN和物理模型进行不确定性量化。
结果· 不同神经网络架构的结果被讨论，并作为多保真不确定性量化框架。
验证· 通过数值基准测试验证神经网络架构的有效性。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Stochastic effects at the microscale cause scatter in experimental data, which were not accounted for in a previous model-based approach for MEMS magnetometers.
Method· A multi-scale deep learning approach is proposed, combining a CNN at the material scale and two feedforward neural networks at the device scale, linked through a physical model to form a hybrid solution.
Result· Different neural network architectures are evaluated, and the approach is framed as a multi-fidelity uncertainty quantification procedure.
Validation· Validation is performed through numerical benchmarks comparing different neural network architectures.

相关性: 该论文提出的深度神经网络结合贝叶斯优化的代理模型方法，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真替代与约束优化问题。
边界: This paper focuses on airfoil aerodynamic optimization, not on biomedical implant design, FEA-based surrogate modeling, or biomechanical constraints.
动机· 快速准确优化翼型气动性能，替代昂贵CFD仿真。
方法· 构建卷积与全连接混合神经网络预测气动系数，结合贝叶斯优化进行形状优化。
结果· 预测精度约99%，优化时间小于2分钟，比传统BO-CFD快两个数量级。
验证· 与文献CFD数据对比验证预测模型和优化结果。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To accelerate airfoil shape optimization by replacing expensive CFD simulations with a fast and accurate surrogate model.
Method· A hybrid neural network with convolutional and fully connected paths is trained to predict aerodynamic coefficients from Hicks-Henne parameterized geometry, then coupled with Bayesian optimization for shape optimization.
Result· The surrogate achieves ~99% prediction accuracy and the optimization completes in under 2 minutes, two orders of magnitude faster than traditional BO-CFD.
Validation· The CFD model is validated against literature data, and the surrogate predictions and optimization results are verified against CFD simulations.

Motivation· To develop a real-time in situ method for quantifying soluble biomarker concentration gradients in 3D cell culture environments.

Motivation· To investigate whether lithium coating on titanium implants via electrochemical deposition enhances early osseointegration.
Method· Lithium coating was electrochemically deposited on titanium implants, which were then implanted in the mandibles of beagle dogs, followed by micro-CT and histological evaluation.

边界: This paper reports clinical outcomes and survival rates but does not include any finite element analysis, stress/strain quantification in Gruen zones, or micromotion modeling.
动机· 评估超短解剖型非骨水泥股骨柄在年轻患者中的长期临床和影像学结果。
方法· 对240例初次全髋关节置换术（患者年龄<30岁）进行平均16年随访，分析临床评分和影像学。
结果· 假体存活率99.2%，无3级应力遮挡，无大腿痛或骨溶解。
验证· 临床随访验证，包括Harris髋关节评分和X线片评估。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the long-term clinical and radiographic outcomes of an ultra-short anatomic cementless femoral stem in patients younger than 30 years.
Method· A retrospective analysis of 240 primary total hip arthroplasties with mean 16-year follow-up, assessing clinical scores and radiographic findings.
Result· Implant survival was 99.2% with no cases of grade 3 stress shielding, thigh pain, or osteolysis.
Validation· Clinical follow-up validation using Harris hip score, WOMAC, and radiographic evaluation.

Motivation· To investigate the correlation between osseointegration and bonding strength at the bone-implant interface for HA and HA/Ti composite coatings.
Method· Coated titanium rods were implanted into rabbit distal femurs and proximal tibias, and after 8 weeks, histological evaluation and pull-out tests were performed.
Result· HA/Ti coatings showed greater osseointegration but no significant increase in bonding strength, indicating no linear correlation between osseointegration extent and bonding strength at 8 weeks.
Validation· In vivo rabbit model with histological analysis and mechanical pull-out testing.

Motivation· To evaluate the performance of custom-made triflange acetabular components in reconstructing severe acetabular bone loss with pelvic discontinuity after THA.

Motivation· To investigate the influence of assembly force on tribocorrosion damage at the head-neck taper junction of hip implants.
Method· An adaptive finite element algorithm was developed to simulate tribocorrosion over four million gait cycles, incorporating both mechanical wear and electrochemical corrosion.
Result· Chemical wear contributed 25-50% of total material loss, and a minimum assembly force of 4 kN was required to maintain junction interlock.
Validation· Simulated damage patterns were compared with those observed in retrieved modular hip implants.

Motivation· To validate 3D biplanar radiography as a low-dose alternative to CT for measuring femoral stem version after total hip arthroplasty.

Motivation· To determine whether systemic melatonin administration at different times of day differentially affects osseointegration of titanium rods in osteoporotic rats.

Motivation· To identify the best arm as quickly as possible in a restless Markov multi-armed bandit setting with known transition matrices but unknown mapping.

Motivation· A standardized classification system for radiological undersizing of femoral stems in total hip arthroplasty is lacking.

Validation· Validation was performed by comparing classification decisions with digital re-templating.

Motivation· To systematically review the prevalence, associated factors, and surgical management of liner dissociation in total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A systematic review following PRISMA guidelines was conducted, searching literature from 2002 to 2022 and including 31 studies.
